notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes:
Fixed level streaming bug that intermittently caused walls and objects to stream in improperly or not stream in at all.

Also put workaround to replace the red cube at Inport front door on the pressure plate so player does not get trapped if the cube accidentally falls off the pressure plate. Hit 9, then 8, then the letter i in sequence and the cube will be placed on the plate..

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes: Quick update for Riddle final gate

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Modifications to Riddle Island gate puzzles to prevent inadvertent trapping of player behind force field (per “Buttercup” in community discussions)

[*] Additional hint notes on Riddle and Grid Islands.

[*] Exposed 6 hidden puzzles (per Stasnia in community discussions). While in game (not in Menu Room), if you hit Y then U, you will be teleported to a normally hidden platform that was a bit of a workshop for puzzle development (it was hidden in the game until Stasnia found it). There are 6 puzzles that are fully functional. They did not make it into the game, though the first 2 could have but were deemed potentially too hard.  The last three are simply too complicated/hard pattern series puzzles and thus did not make it into the game.  There are hints using the H and N keys. To get back to Inport, hit Y then M.  There is no save function for these puzzles, however.

[/list]

notes.title: Small Update - Mostly Additional Hints in Easy Mode
notes.notes:
Hi All,

Small update that inserts several more hint notes into game that are exposed when you place yourself in "Easier" mode (Keyboard H for hints and thus easier mode, keyboard N for normal play node). Also a few minor non-game breaking bugs fixed.

As usual, if you find any issues with this update, please send mail to support@sonoma.games.

Joe

notes.title: Very Minor Update
notes.notes:
Hi All,

Just a small update fixing a couple minor recent bugs.

[list]
[*] If the UPS door is inadvertently closed while inside UPS building in West due to cube falling off pressure plate, the door can now be opened from the inside by clicking on doorknob (Deadmeat)

[*] Eliminated location that trapped character in UPS building (Gena_Snow)

[*] Could not reproduce a reported Refinery issue but moved props to block character from an area under the walkway that caused a character to be permanently stuck (Ryan)

[*] Fixed entry apartment TV multi-play issue (Ryan)

[*] A few other unreported nuances also fixed 
[/list]

As usual, if you find any bugs, please send to support@sonoma.games and I will jump on them.

I have a prototype of the Options/Settings panel running but need to extensively test it - it will be included in an October update.

Thanks

notes.title: Game Update Uploaded to Steam, Considering Exit From Early Access
notes.notes:
A potentially final game update prior to exit from early access was just uploaded to Steam.  It includes several minor bug fixes and a few other notable items:

[list]
[*] Mouse sensitivity can now be adjusted at any time just by using the up arrow or down arrow keys.
[*] A completely new environment was created for a mine.
[*] Ambient outside sound versus inside sound was fine-tuned
[*] Added an Easter Egg
[/list]

Bug reports have slowed to a trickle.  I will let this update bake a bit but if bug reports continue to be a trickle, the game will hopefully exit early access later this week.  

If you find a bug, please send a description to support@sonoma.games.  Thanks.
